text: Which system integration specialists in Canberra are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

sections.text:

---

## 🏆 Top System Integration Specialists in Canberra

---

### 1. 🔷 AMBR IT (Canberra)
**Website:** ambrit.com.au
**Best for:** Government, federal contractors, ERP + CRM integration

AMBR IT is one of Canberra's most prominent technology-agnostic business systems integration partners.
They are described as "Australia's trusted business systems integration partner," implementing ERP, CRM, and automation solutions across Dynamics, Salesforce, Business Central, and custom platforms.
They have delivered 500+ projects with zero data loss, fixed-price delivery, and local support.

For Canberra government contractors specifically, they configure Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central to connect contract registers to AusTender, milestone billing into project accounting, and SharePoint-backed document trails — with the ERP tenant deployed into Azure Australia Central or Australia East for data sovereignty.
**Platforms covered:**
Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Salesforce, HubSpot, Power Platform, ServiceNow, Xero, SAP Business One, NetSuite, Zendesk, Power BI, and SharePoint.

---

### 2. 🔷 ERP IT Canberra
**Website:** erp-it-canberra.com.au
**Best for:** Financial systems, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, MYOB

A locally based Canberra consultancy with deep financial systems expertise.

The consultants are proficient in software solution delivery and specialise in ERP Systems and Financial Technology, with extensive experience across major financial system products including SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, TechnologyOne, Oracle Financials, Xero, and MYOB.
They help customers integrate directly through web services and automation bots, transform data to native reporting formats, and configure system controls to reduce data error rates.

### 3. 🔷 Cloud Factory (Australia-wide, serving Canberra)
**Website:** cloudfactory.co
**Best for:** MYOB Acumatica, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

Cloud Factory provides end-to-end ERP consulting, implementation, and optimisation services, helping organisations modernise operations through cloud ERP platforms including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, SAP Business One, and MYOB Acumatica — delivering connected systems that unify finance, operations, inventory, warehouse, and customer management.

With certifications and extensive experience across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, SAP Business One, and MYOB Acumatica, they combine technical expertise with practical industry knowledge to help businesses modernise legacy systems and adopt scalable cloud ERP platforms.

---

### 4. 🔷 Bright Labs (Australia-wide, serving Canberra)
**Website:** brightlabs.com.au
**Best for:** CRM & ERP integration with websites, apps, and custom systems
Bright Labs designs and delivers CRM and ERP integrations that connect websites, web applications, and mobile apps with the systems that run your business.

Platforms they integrate with include enterprise and mid-market ERPs (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365), financial and accounting systems (Xero, MYOB, Sage), CRM and marketing platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), and custom, proprietary, and legacy systems — including those with limited or non-standard APIs.

---

### 5. 🔷 OfficePro Consulting (Australia-wide, serving Canberra)
**Website:** officeproconsulting.com.au
**Best for:** CRM integration, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, AI automation
OfficePro Consulting builds bi-directional CRM integrations that keep Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365, and your operational tools in sync, so every team works from the same source of truth.

Their expertise spans business process automation, AI agents, Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, and system integration — connecting Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365, and other CRM platforms to accounting, ERP, and operational systems.
